name: page-faq-hub
description: Help-centre FAQ for /faq/: a sticky topic list with question counts and an instant search beside topic groups (each an h2) of questions (h3) that open in place; on phones the topics become a sideways chip row over the search. Answers take paragraphs, bulleted and numbered lists, **bold** and [label](url) links. One FAQPage JSON-LD for every question. Search, topic highlight and the empty state are behaviour.js; without it every question shows and opens on click.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

nav_title.description: Small label over the topic list.

search.description: Show the search box (filters questions and answers as you type).

search_label.description: Search box label (visually hidden) and placeholder.

empty_text.description: Shown when a search leaves nothing; [label](url) links allowed.

open_first.description: Open the first question of the first topic.

schema.description: Print one FAQPage JSON-LD with every question (answers as plain text).

groups.description: Topics, in order. Each: title (the topic h2), optional id (anchor; derived from the title when empty), items (array of {q, a}). In a: a blank line starts a new block; a block whose lines all start with '- ' is a bulleted list, '1. ' a numbered list; otherwise a paragraph (line breaks kept). [label](url) links and **bold** anywhere.
